**Credit first: PR2226 (Cinna Davis / 1337isnot1337, with OpenAI Codex assistance), anticipatory dirty borrowing.** This package applies it to the previous record's two T74 local words (pivot-566+554): borrow-word rebuild and independent audit (`new/rebuild_borrow.py`, `new/borrow/`), native lowering with warp recipes (`new/run_native_borrow.py`, `new/code/borrow/`), a window-exact owner fill for the 437-helper words, certified fine endpoints and exact outer witness. Applies PR2226 (Cinna Davis / 1337isnot1337) anticipatory dirty borrowing to both T74 local words: 43 high helpers (8 width-4, 35 width-5) alias retired fields through exact monomial reference changes K_G (rank-zero Gaussian handoffs), helpers 480 to 437, local mass 5590 to 5385; window-exact owner fill, fresh natives with warp recipes, certified endpoints and exact outer witness.

**New in this package (credit Jeremy Kothe (jeremykothe2), with AI assistance): exact frame refit of the borrowed gauge44 word.** The borrowed word's frames were not frame-optimal. An exact re-solve of the frames (an exact frame-solver toolkit `frames.optimal_frames`, certified; lenders split at the warps) edits 42 gate frames (21 in A, 20 in B, 1 in the restore) with gates, warps, restore order, mass 5385 and widths unchanged and moves the local profile from {1:2351, 2:501, 3:414, 4:129, 5:42, 8:8} to {1:2339, 2:509, 3:418, 4:125, 5:42, 8:8}. The word `new/borrow/words/BORROW-WORD-43base.json.gz` is rebuilt from the canonical base as before and the exact patch `new/borrow/inputs/refit_43base.json` is applied by `new/rebuild_borrow.py`; the pre-refit word still passes the pinned audit against the canonical base (`new/borrow/receipts/AUDIT-43base-pinned.json`), while the refit word is audited independently (forward and dual free-algebra replay, `new/borrow/receipts/AUDIT-43base.json`) without the base pin, because the refit changes frames inside the pinned A section; a tampered refit frame is rejected. The refit word is the previous state of the kernel step below. This package also corrects the text defects found by the PR2286 audit (thakrarsagar; related checks by philippeVV): see `outer/FINE-PADDING-COMPOSITION.md` section 4.

**New in this package (Jeremy Kothe (jeremykothe2), with AI assistance; kernel shape from PR1625, mdumitrean): two exact helper-donor kernels, at pivots 518 and 506, on both borrowed words.** Each kernel replaces one read of its pivot register in the B section by four other reads (every one a coefficient +-1 add reading the pivot), and all frames are re-solved exactly; local profile {1:2341, 2:505, 3:420, 4:125, 5:42, 8:8} plus 8 width-8 helpers, mass 5385 unchanged. `new/rebuild_borrow.py` rebuilds each word from the canonical base, applies the refit patch (gauge44 word) and the kernel patch (`new/borrow/inputs/kernel_43base.json`, `kernel_43extra.json`, applied by `new/borrow/word_patch.py`, which also re-derives the explicit inverse-reverse cleanup), checks that the shipped B section differs from the previous state by exactly the declared gate-level edit (reads of the declared pivots only; frames ignored), audits the previous state and the shipped word independently (forward and dual free-algebra replay; the pinned pre-refit word and, for the extra word, the unpatched word are audited against the canonical base: `new/borrow/receipts/AUDIT-43*-pinned.json`, `AUDIT-43*-prekernel.json`, `AUDIT-43*.json`), and requires that sign-flipped, dropped, doubled or moved kernel reads are rejected (`new/borrow/receipts/CONTROLS-KERNEL-43*.json`). The correctness of the kernel is the exact audit of the final word (every remaining input an independent column, exact endpoint map); the `ops` pivot-chain checker of the pre-borrow 566+554 chain (`new/pivotcheck.py`, `new/rebuild_chain.py`) is unchanged and still applies to the pre-borrow words. Native chains, rebind, discovery and the strict T74 assembly are rerun on both words; the extra word, whose frames were already optimal, now also carries re-solved frames.

Independent concurrent work: PR2260 (Dugongue) and PR2265 (DreamingOfClouds, the PR2220 outer retune applied to PR2260's supplier) apply the same PR2226 anticipatory dirty-borrowing mechanism to the selected T8 parent; this package applies it to the T74 pivot-566+554 words and exceeds PR2265 by about 1.30e-5.

**Precision of this package** (`new/SPEC.json:outer_refinement`, `CLAIM.json:outer_refinement`): endpoint_digits 3000 (the native and conservative complex endpoints are certified to 1e-3000: accept at the endpoint, reject at endpoint + 1e-3000, by finer-constant copies of both fine engines (`code/fine_mercator.py`, `code/fine_moment.py`) in directed-rounding integer fixed point, floor for lower and ceiling for upper bounds), grid_digits 2995 (the final kappa grid), margin_digits 3005, bootstrap_steps 1116; kappa decimals are printed with 3120 significant digits. Every free slack of the ledger is the fixed-grid-maximum point of PR2180 / PR2161 (dataisfire) at this package's own endpoint: r0, layout slack, q gap and endpoint gap 1e-3080, epsilon = 1 - (1025/1024) 1e-3080, beta = 1 - 3 (1025/1024) 1e-3080, zeta 1e-3082, stop 1e-3086, backoff 1e-3022, kappa floor grid 1e-3046. With C the certified complex endpoint, F the floor denominator and B the backoff, the ledger kappa is exactly C - 1/F - B, the maximum of the declared floor-grid/backoff family (every point has epsilon q < C and C F is an integer, so floor(F epsilon q)/F <= C - 1/F; attained since 0 < C - epsilon q < 1/F, checked exactly; `outer/PROOF-GRID-MAX.md`). The main-binding family condition (Gaussian saving minus main saving = delta (1 - 2q) > 0) is an explicit 63rd strict row `gaussian_above_main`; the 62 earlier strict inequalities and all 17 rejecting controls are retained. The single 3000-digit rejection moment of the strict assembly uses the exact-integer coarse exponential of PR2168 (dataisfire; derivation as PR2184): `code/exact_coarse.py`, `EXACT-ARITHMETIC-DERIVATION.json`, intervals identical to the retained engine. Margins are asymptotic: the all-size statements still need p beyond an astronomically large cutoff.

`new/CHAIN.json` lists every kernel step; `new/rebuild_chain.py` re-verifies each step against its own base words (exact B + early-cleanup map over all rows, remaining cleanup, interfaces). Pivot reads: every inserted read of the pivot q must see the row of q equal to s*I with s = +1 or -1 (`new/pivotcheck.py`); a pivot restored by a sign-flipping cleanup gate is read with that sign. Tamper controls (signs unaccounted; each new coefficient moved one dyadic step) must all fail the map check.

Repairs retained: the PR1956 carried bootstrap cutoffs (every stage cutoff carries the previous constant; exact check at proof time, with the control that the uncarried cutoffs fail) and the PR1964 Lemma G extended-label stage `lemmag-labels` with the X/Y/Z adapter mutants.

# PR1625's pivot-566 helper-donor kernel on the T74 exact fill, with certified 1e-3000 endpoints and a 1e-2995 outer witness

4. Stage `lemmag-labels` (beside the frame-only `local-replay`; `code/lemmag_stage.py` with `code/lemmag_checks.py`, vendored verbatim from PR1964 by thakrarsagar / Sagar Thakrar; Lemma G by DreamingOfClouds, PR509 / PR516): runs the Lemma G extended-label check (`label_check`, strict and permissive readings) and the adapter rule (`adapter_rule`) on each provider's emitted LOCAL-PROGRAMS in both orientations, asserting 0 violations, and requires the three physically wrong adapter mutants that the frame-only replay accepts (X exit straddle, Y entry straddle, Z exit adapters moved before a phase-B add) to be REJECTED on every provider.

The top-level PLAN.json/SPEC.json are the unchanged PR1424/PR1319 files used by the owner reconstruction and parent lift checks; the strict stage uses `new/`. All 47 strict outer inequalities, the rejection controls and next-grid rejection hold (checked offline with the package's own outer witness and engine). The remaining gap to the exact root is the 1e-3000 endpoint bracket; the displayed digits are set by the 1e-2995 grid.

The three witness settings are frozen in `SPEC.json:outer_refinement`: 12 bootstrap iterations, eta = beta = 10^-40 with target backoff 10^-43, and a 10^-36 final κ grid. The inherited complex and bit endpoint grids and their native/surcharge models remain unchanged. Every bootstrap cutoff is recomputed from the exact gap. The next final κ grid point rejects for this witness. No optimality over all outer parameters is claimed.

The recurrence is a_(j+1) = (1-s)s + s a_j. Its closed form is a_j = s - (s-a_0)s^j; 0 < a_0 < s < 1 gives a finite increasing chain below s. This only changes witnesses to the inherited conditional bootstrap and outer lemmas, whose assumptions remain in force. Root endpoints, arithmetic engines and finite construction are inherited unchanged.

Reproduce complete admission with `python3 -B verify.py --work /absolute/new/work --base-native-from /bound/base/native --extra-native-from /bound/extra/native`, or omit the two reuse flags for fresh native supplier runs. The output directory must not exist and assertions must be enabled. `evidence/OUTER-DISCOVERY.json` is discovery evidence, not a completed new-package replay. `evidence/pr1377/` contains predecessor receipts; inherited `PRICE.json` and input/parent receipts are not new verification.

Conditional finite construction only. All-size compiler, common-label/mutable-source realization, whole-call hosting, precision/tape, exact recovery, analytic transfer, PR559 recurrence correction and PR589 bit H1-H5 assumptions remain. No unconditional theorem, full Lean certification, or global packing claim.
